review.method: Primary agent source comparison; all previous boundary fields and evaluation order retained. Exact tuple string equality; no hashes or cached callback state used by production detector.

limitations: Three repeats of six fixed cases; not a training-corpus throughput estimate.
Fresh process startup included; machine load and OS caches uncontrolled.
Before/after source snapshots share new mutation regressions; unrelated working-tree edits excluded.
BotSim build clean; NNTrain builds had the same ten existing CS8632 warnings.
Passing software checks does not certify authentic KARDS rule parity.
